role: Gate: replays the oracle's GhastProbe dump (Nether region, cavern carve, natural-style ghast spawns, per-tick updates) through csrc/engine/ghasts.c and compares every entity field, fireball, explosion block write, player health, Det digest and the final blocks after each tick.

structs.name: splitref
structs.java: one Det split stream (determinize.sh static RNG name) per role

structs.name: ref
structs.java: the oracle's Det start.txt/end.txt snapshot (netherite.oracle.Det: world seed, per-role nextId, seeder/math digests, split streams)

notes: Test harness, built with -Dmain=gate_test_main behind tests/input_guard.c; not linked into the product and never on the tick path. make -C csrc test runs it on every directory under out/java/ghasts. Native calls: gh_spawn_ghast, gh_tick, gh_fireball_impact hook, ghast_fireball_nbt_text/hash (csrc/engine/ghasts.c), an_init/an_free, living_nbt_text/hash, world_init/world_load_chunk/world_set_block, det_* role streams, nbt_parse/nbt_diff. Reads manifest.json, start.txt, shapes.bin, spawns.bin, spawns.txt.gz, ticks.bin.gz, removals.txt.gz, digest.txt.gz, final.bin.gz and nbt/. Negative checks --negative=attack (threshold 15) and --negative=waypoint (12.0F) must fail. Oracle side: oracle/harness/netherite/oracle/GhastProbe.java. Recordings: out/java/ghasts/gh-b2, gh-b2r, gh-b2w, gh-b42. Java member names in the java list are from the probe's description, not verified line by line against EntityGhast.java.
